voiceover.hook: Only six Pokémon. Can this Kanto team really beat the Elite Four?
voiceover.outro: Which Pokémon would you swap out? Tell me in the comments below.

line.text: Against Bruno, we bring in Pidgeot. Sky Attack knocks out Machamp in one hit, and that decides the fight. Take Down comes from TM9.
Agatha looks scary, but Raichu makes it easy. Thunder wipes out Golbat in a single hit. It spreads paralysis, so slower enemies can barely move.
Lt. Surge looks scary, but Dugtrio makes it easy. Dig knocks out Pikachu in one hit. You can get it in Digletts Cave.
Against Koga, we bring in Hypno. Psychic knocks out Koffing in one hit, and that decides the fight. Mega Kick comes from TM5.
Our next pick is Venomoth, and Double-Edge becomes its main weapon from TM10. It can put opponents to sleep, which wins fights on its own.
Next up is Omastar. You can get it by reviving a fossil in Cinnabar Island Cinnabar Lab, and Hydro Pump comes at level 49.
